description.title: A hardwood retreat, open to the Black Sea.
description.p1: Set on a low rise above the lagoon, Bungalow 1 is a single-level pavilion of local hardwoods, with a deep timber deck, a salt-water plunge pool, and louvered walls that fold back to the trade winds.
description.p2: Inside, a king bed faces the sea through a wall of glass; a freestanding stone tub looks the same direction. Mornings begin with the sun coming up through the palms; evenings end with the lagoon's soft phosphorescence under the stars.
description.p3: Bungalow 1 includes a dedicated butler, twice-daily housekeeping, and a private outrigger berth at the resort dock for guests who'd like to take to the water on their own schedule.

meta.title: Bungalow 2 — Vayana Bungalows
meta.description: A two-level hilltop residence with infinity pool, private chef's table, and panoramic views. From $1,240 per night.

hero.title: Bungalow 2
hero.sub: A two-level hardwood pavilion above the lagoon, with the whole island laid out below.

description.title: A two-level pavilion above the lagoon.
description.p1: Bungalow 2 is a two-level hardwood pavilion set into the slope above the lagoon. The lower floor opens to a long infinity pool that reads, from the water, as a single sheet to the horizon; the upper floor is the private bedroom, with the island falling away in every direction.
description.p2: A chef's table on the deck seats six and is paired with a kitchen for in-residence dining; on most evenings the resort's executive chef will cook for guests on request, with a single-day notice. The view shifts every half hour from the trade-wind palms to the open sea.
description.p3: Bungalow 2 includes a dedicated butler, twice-daily housekeeping, and an electric buggy for the run down to the beach club. Children are welcome; the second bedroom converts to twin beds on request.

meta.title: Bungalow 3 — Vayana Bungalows

hero.title: Bungalow 3

description.title: Right on the sand, just above the tide.
description.p1: Bungalow 3 sits on the long shallow arc of the resort's main beach. The deck is the sand; a few steps from the bed and you're in the lagoon, where the water is calf-deep and warm for fifty metres out.
description.p2: Inside, the suite is a single open volume with a king bed, a deep tub on the seaward wall, and a soft palette of bleached oak and natural linen. A separate outdoor shower under the palms is the way most guests start the day.
description.p3: Bungalow 3 includes a dedicated butler, twice-daily housekeeping, and a private cabana on the beach with a daybed for two and a service bell. The cabana is the kind of place that quietly redraws an afternoon.

hero.title: On the Black Sea coast
hero.sub: A small port town on Bulgaria's southern Black Sea coast, framed by the Strandzha pine forest and a long ribbon of quiet beaches.

guide.lede: Tsarevo sits at the southern end of the Bulgarian Black Sea coast, where the Strandzha National Park's pine ridges run all the way down to the water.
guide.intro_para1: It's an old fishing port that grew slowly — small harbour, a single ridge, a tight grid of low-rise streets — and the seasonality is gentle. The beaches stretch in both directions: Veleka and Sinemorets to the south, the sweep of Tsarevo bay to the north, and a string of unnamed coves in between.
guide.intro_para2: It's reachable by car in a little over an hour from Burgas Airport (BOJ, ~85 km) and by a long drive from Sofia (SOF, ~410 km). Most guests fly into BOJ; the route hugs the coast from Burgas south, with the sea on the left almost all the way down.

beach.img_alt: A wide stretch of soft sand running into the Black Sea — characteristic of the long, quiet beaches around Tsarevo
beach.title: Beaches and coves
beach.body: Long open beaches give way to small, half-hidden coves the further south you walk. Veleka, just down the coast, is one of the cleanest river-mouth beaches in the country; the smaller bays north of town are reachable only on foot or by water and rarely crowded, even in August.

food.img_alt: An aerial view of clear turquoise water meeting a palm-fringed white sand beach
food.title: Restaurants and local food
food.body: Most of what's good is within walking distance of the harbour: fresh Black Sea catch, mussels and rapana from the bay, and a handful of small family kitchens that serve mezze under grapevines. A few inland wineries in the Strandzha foothills run tasting days through the warm months.

hiking.img_alt: A warm sunrise over a calm sea, with soft pink and gold light on the shoreline
hiking.title: Hiking and nature
hiking.body: Strandzha National Park — the largest protected area in Bulgaria — begins at the edge of town and runs inland for tens of kilometres. Marked trails follow the river valleys; the migratory bird routes overhead in spring and autumn are reason enough for a long walk, even if you don't normally count yourself a birder.

villages.img_alt: A jagged mountain peak rising above a sea of clouds at sunset, washed in pink and gold light
villages.title: Nearby villages and culture
villages.body: Sinemorets and Ahtopol are short drives down the coast, each with its own character — Sinemorets quieter and built around its river-mouth beach, Ahtopol with a working harbour and a small old town on a headland. Inland, Strandzha villages keep older traditions alive, including the fire-dancing rituals that the region is known for.

head.title: Privacy Policy
head.lede: This page explains what personal data Vayana Bungalows collects, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and what rights you have over it under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Bulgarian data-protection law.

updated.title: 1. Last updated
updated.para_before: This Privacy Policy was last updated on
updated.para_after: . See §12 Changes to this policy for how we handle future updates.

who.title: 2. Who we are
who.para1: We are {brand}, operated by Vayana di Mare, a Bulgarian hospitality business operating under licence number {license}.
who.para2_before: Our registered location is {address_street}, {address_country}. For any privacy-related question you can reach us by email at
who.para3: For the purposes of GDPR, we are the data controller for any personal data submitted through this website.

collect.title: 3. What data we collect
collect.intro: We only collect personal data that you actively provide to us, plus a small amount of technical data that our anti-spam tools need to operate. We do not run any analytics, advertising, or behavioural-tracking tools on this site.
collect.form_title: 3.1 Data you give us through the enquiry form
collect.form_intro_after: collects the following fields. All are submitted only when you choose to submit the form:
collect.form_field_message: A free-text message describing your enquiry
collect.form_field_consent: A consent checkbox confirming you agree to be contacted (this is logged together with the submission, so we have a record of your consent — see §4)
collect.form_flow: When you submit the form, your data is sent to a Cloudflare Worker running on Cloudflare's global edge network, which validates the submission and appends a row to a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace (EU region). See §6 Who we share data with and §7 Where data is stored for the processors involved, and §8 How long we keep data for the retention period.
collect.captcha_intro: The enquiry form is protected against bots by Cloudflare Turnstile in managed mode. When you submit the form, Turnstile collects, on Cloudflare's behalf:
collect.captcha_ip_before: Your IP address — sent by your browser directly to Cloudflare's
collect.captcha_ip_after: endpoint together with the challenge token
collect.captcha_browser: Browser characteristics (user agent, screen size, plug-in list)
collect.captcha_signals: Interaction signals on the form page (mouse / keyboard movement timing)
collect.captcha_note_before: The captcha data above does not pass through our servers in clear form — it goes directly from your browser to Cloudflare, which returns only a success / failure result to our Worker. Our Worker logs only a salted SHA-256 hash of your IP address (not the raw address) into the Google Sheet, as
collect.captcha_note_after: , so we can correlate repeat enquiries without storing identifying data. We rotate the salt periodically; rotation makes earlier hashes uncorrelatable with any future submission, which is the intended privacy property.
collect.maps_title: 3.3 Cookies and tracking from embedded Google Maps
collect.maps_body: The map on the homepage and on Contacts / Destination embeds a Google Maps iframe. When the page loads the iframe, Google may set cookies in your browser and receive your IP address — this happens automatically as soon as the page is rendered, whether or not you interact with the map. We have no control over what Google collects in that context — please see Google's own privacy policy.
collect.newsletter_body: The newsletter signup form on the homepage accepts an email address into an input field but, in version 1, that email is not stored anywhere and is not transmitted off your device — submitting the form opens a "thank you" modal and discards what you typed. When a real email-service-provider integration ships, this section will be updated in the same release to list the provider and what they receive.

why.title: 4. Why we collect it (legal basis)
why.consent: Your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). The enquiry form processes your data on the basis of the consent you give by ticking the checkbox above the submit button. You can withdraw that consent at any time — see §9.
why.legitimate: Our legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). The captcha service that runs alongside the form processes the technical data listed in §3.2 to protect our site from automated spam submissions. We have weighed this interest against your rights and consider it proportionate, since the data captured is the minimum required to score a request as bot-or-human.

use.title: 5. How we use it
use.intro: We use the data you give us solely to:
use.item_reply: Reply to your enquiry with a tailored proposal
use.item_record: Hold a record of your stated preferences in case you reply later in the same thread
use.outro: We do not use enquiry data for marketing. We do not share it with advertising networks. We do not run any automated decision-making or profiling on it.

third.title: 6. Third parties
third.intro: When you use this site, the following third parties may process some of your personal data on our behalf:
third.google: Google LLC — for the embedded Google Maps iframe (§3.3) and for storing enquiry submissions in a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace (EU region, §7). Google's processing is governed by its own privacy policy and the Google Workspace Data Processing Addendum.
third.cloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc. — for hosting the Cloudflare Worker that accepts your enquiry submission (§3.1) and for the Cloudflare Turnstile anti-spam check that runs before submission (§3.2). Cloudflare's processing is governed by its own privacy policy and its customer Data Processing Addendum.
third.github: GitHub, Inc. — this website is served as a static site through GitHub Pages. GitHub receives your IP address and basic request metadata in the course of serving the page. GitHub's processing is governed by its own privacy statement.

storage.title: 7. Where data is stored
storage.intro: The static website itself contains no stored personal data. When you submit the enquiry form:
storage.item_edge: Your submission passes through Cloudflare's globally distributed edge network — the Worker that processes it runs on Cloudflare's edge close to your location, then writes only to the destinations below.
storage.item_sheet: The validated submission is appended as a row to a Google Sheet held in Google Workspace, with the storage region set to the European Union.
storage.item_hash_before: Only a salted SHA-256 hash of your IP address is written to the sheet (in the
storage.item_hash_after: column) — the raw IP is never stored at rest on our side.
storage.encryption: In-flight TLS encryption is provided by Cloudflare (between your browser and the Worker) and by Google (between the Worker and the Sheets API). At-rest encryption on Google Workspace is provided by Google.

retention.title: 8. How long we keep it
retention.para1: We keep enquiry data for the minimum time necessary to respond to you and follow up. Our current target is to delete enquiry records 12 months after the last interaction in that thread.
retention.para2: If your enquiry becomes a booking, the booking-related data is retained under our booking terms (not this policy). If your enquiry does not become a booking, the 12-month window applies.
retention.para3: The "12 months" figure is provisional and will be confirmed before launch.

rights.title: 9. Your rights
rights.intro_before: Under GDPR, you have the following rights over the data we hold about you. To exercise any of them, email us at
rights.intro_after: and we will respond within one calendar month.
rights.access: Access (Art. 15) — ask us for a copy of what we hold about you.
rights.rectification: Rectification (Art. 16) — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
rights.erasure: Erasure (Art. 17) — ask us to delete your data, where one of the grounds in Art. 17(1) applies.
rights.restriction: Restriction (Art. 18) — ask us to pause processing while we investigate a dispute.
rights.portability: Portability (Art. 20) — ask us to send you (or another controller) a machine-readable copy.
rights.object: Object (Art. 21) — object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interest (§4).
rights.withdraw: Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)) — withdraw the consent you gave on the enquiry form at any time, by emailing us. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out before the withdrawal.
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP) if you believe we have mishandled your data.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies
cookies.intro: We do not set any first-party cookies on this site. Cookies are only set by embedded third-party content:
cookies.maps: Google Maps — sets cookies and receives your IP address when the embedded map iframe loads on the homepage, the Contacts page, and the Destination page; see Google's own cookie disclosures
cookies.turnstile_before: Cloudflare Turnstile — in managed mode, Turnstile does not set cookies for most visitors. If a visitor is challenged for pre-clearance (rare; happens for traffic that looks abusive), Cloudflare may set a
cookies.turnstile_after: cookie scoped to the Turnstile challenge domain. See Cloudflare's cookie reference.
cookies.outro: We do not run any analytics, advertising, or behavioural-tracking cookies. If that changes — for example if we add a newsletter analytics tool — we will add a cookie banner before doing so and update this section.

contact.title: 11. How to contact us about data
contact.intro: For anything related to your data — access requests, corrections, deletions, complaints, or just questions about this policy — please email us:
contact.outro: We aim to acknowledge data-related emails within five working days, and to substantively reply within one calendar month, as GDPR requires.

changes.title: 12. Changes to this policy
changes.para1: We may update this policy from time to time — for example when we add a new third-party service, change our retention schedule, or in response to a regulatory update. Whenever we update it, we change the "last updated" date at the top.
changes.para2: For material changes (anything that affects what we collect, why we collect it, or how long we keep it), we will additionally announce the change on the homepage for a reasonable period of time so that returning visitors notice.

head.title: Cancellation Policy
head.lede1: This Cancellation Policy explains what happens if you need to cancel or modify a reservation at {brand}. It is part of, and should be read together with, our Terms & Conditions.
head.lede2: This page is a draft. Every figure rendered in a yellow highlight (lead-time threshold, refund percentage, SLA, currency) is a working assumption and MUST be reviewed and replaced before this site goes live to paying guests.

tiers.title: 2. Cancellation tiers
tiers.intro: If you need to cancel a confirmed reservation, the refund you receive depends on how many days before your check-in date we receive the written cancellation request:
tiers.tier1_c: of any amount you have paid. Free cancellation tier.
tiers.tier2_d: of any amount you have paid. Partial-refund tier.
tiers.lead_time: The lead time is counted from the date and time we receive your written cancellation (see §3), not the date you sent it. Tiers apply to the total amount you have paid us toward the reservation, including any deposit described in §5 of the Terms & Conditions.

how_to_cancel.title: 3. How to cancel
how_to_cancel.email_intro: To cancel a reservation, please email us at
how_to_cancel.email_rest: with your booking reference (sent in the confirmation email), the dates of your reservation, and a short note that you wish to cancel.
how_to_cancel.ack_a: We will acknowledge your cancellation in writing within
how_to_cancel.ack_b: , confirm the applicable refund tier per §2, and let you know the timeline for the refund per §7. Until you have received that written acknowledgement from us, please consider the cancellation as pending.

modifications.title: 4. Modifications
modifications.intro: Date changes and guest-count changes are treated differently from full cancellations and are usually handled at no charge if requested far enough in advance:
modifications.date_b: before the original check-in date, for new dates of equal length and the same bungalow, are free of charge subject to availability. Closer to check-in, or for longer stays / different bungalows, a price difference or fee may apply.
modifications.guest_count: Guest-count changes. Adding or removing guests within the bungalow's stated occupancy limit is free of charge; we ask you to let us know in advance so we can prepare the bungalow accordingly. Exceeding the occupancy limit is not permitted; see §8 House rules of the Terms & Conditions.
modifications.fallback: If a modification cannot be accommodated and you choose to cancel instead, the cancellation tier in §2 applies based on the original check-in date.

no_shows.title: 5. No-shows
no_shows.body_a: If you do not arrive on your check-in date and have not cancelled in writing before the check-in time, the reservation is treated as a no-show. The default refund for a no-show is
no_shows.exceptions: If circumstances beyond your control prevent you from arriving, please contact us as soon as you can — see §6 Force majeure for how we handle exceptions.

force_majeure.title: 6. Force majeure
force_majeure.body: Sometimes events beyond either party's control — natural disasters, sudden travel restrictions, or regional emergencies — make a stay impossible. In those cases we will work with you in good faith to find a fair outcome, which may include moving the dates free of charge, holding the amount you have paid as credit toward a future stay, or issuing a refund outside the standard tiers in §2.
force_majeure.legal_basis: The legal basis for force majeure (what qualifies, who bears which costs, and how the refund is calculated) is set out in §10 of the Terms & Conditions. This Policy and those Terms should be read together.

refund_processing.title: 7. Refund processing
refund_processing.timeline_a: Once the refund tier is confirmed under §2 (or under §6 for force majeure), refunds are issued within
refund_processing.method_b: to the same payment method you used to pay the original deposit and balance. If that is not possible (for example, the card has expired), we will contact you to agree an alternative method.

disputes.title: 8. Disputes
disputes.body_a: If you disagree with how this Policy has been applied to your reservation, please first contact us at the email in §3 and describe what you would like us to reconsider. We will respond in writing and try to find a resolution within
disputes.governing_law: If we cannot reach an agreement, the dispute-resolution and governing-law provisions in §11 of the Terms & Conditions apply, including the courts named there. Nothing in this Policy limits any consumer rights you may have under applicable mandatory law.
